body:
Tested locally, it works as expected with all camera modes (perspective, orthogonal, frustum).

**Testing project:** [test_pr_103553.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19193360/test_pr_103553.zip)

Note that this can only be used from RenderingServer, not the Camera3D node properties. The Camera3D node's scale is not automatically applied to affect the aspect ratio, which is probably a good thing here as we wouldn't want parent node scaling to affect the node's aspect ratio.

**Note for reviewers:** Comments at the top refer to a previous state of this PR where it allowed using arbitrary custom projection matrices. This PR now only allows scaling the Camera3D node's projection matrix to change the aspect ratio it displays, which can be used for various distortion effects. This can also be used for [non-square pixel ratios](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/11160) while still rendering at native resolution. However, it does not suffice on its own to implement portals or planar reflections.
